detail.longDescription: OpenAI posted 722 math manuscripts by an unreleased model, then withdrew three a day later over a sign error. 42% carry a machine-checked Lean proof. The rest are a refereeing load nobody has a mechanism for. Generation isn't the bottleneck in maths any more.
